model: HTN104 Thermal Dispersion Airflow / Temperature Transmitter (firmware 1.x)
applies_to: EBTRON HTN104 thermal dispersion airflow and temperature measurement transmitters with BACnet MS/TP (firmware 1.x).
summary: The HTN104 is an EBTRON thermal dispersion airflow and temperature transmitter with a BACnet MS/TP port. Its PICS object table lists three analog inputs (airflow, pressure, temperature) and four analog values (free area, baud rate, airflow and temperature traverse).
notes: The object list comes from Table 1 of the 2011 PICS; units of the analog inputs are selectable (writable Units property).
Access: Present Value is writable for AV 1 Free Area and AV 2 Baud Rate; the other objects are read-only (AI Present Value only when out of service).

source.title: HTN104 BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement

integration.summary: Read airflow (AI 1), temperature (AI 3) and pressure (AI 2). Set the duct free area (AV 1) so the airflow reading is right.
setup: BACnet MS/TP master at 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 baud (AV 2).

points.name: Airflow
points.description: Units FPM, CFM, MPS or LPS

points.name: Free Area
points.description: Duct free area used for the airflow calculation
